Keep duplicate implementations and original states unless exact existing evidence permits reference reuse. Keep old8 library as common fixed prior; retain old30/D1/D2 artifacts as ordinary accessible regression evidence.

automatic_groups.archive: Strong common archive and ordinary code/native tools; no automatic PR2 or new consolidation.
automatic_groups.fixed_pr2: Same archive, common old frozen library and fixed PR2; no automatic new-source consolidation.

design.object_use: Current automatic learner emits exact_edit_map plus existing structural construction/revision objects. parameter_proposal consumer support alone is not automatic learning of an initializer.

object_qualification_before_target.source_identity: At least2 distinct new physical source IDs from the preregistered three; ABC/recovery/repeated rows do not multiply source count.
object_qualification_before_target.reconstruction: Existing exact source reconstruction and executable declared types/roles/units; preserve missing contracts and UNKNOWN.
object_qualification_before_target.status: Local executable proposal only; preserve active/inactive, failures/counterexamples and purpose; global source success/independent confirmation not inherited.
object_qualification_before_target.newness: At least one actual current-source generation record. Old8 and old aliases retain old identity. Compare against common old objects/templates and preserve baseline reconstructibility.
object_qualification_before_target.selection: First lexicographic qualified new candidate after the complete registered source stage; choose no replacement if none qualifies.
object_qualification_before_target.freeze: Complete all source tasks, close source/aggregation accounts, fix object/library/index/alias/derivative references before materializing successor labels.

whole_strategy.primary: C minus B over all preregistered source and successor cases; B minus A separately.
whole_strategy.no_new_object: Retain source generation failure in the method denominator and continue the preregistered whole-strategy successor with B fixed library as C fallback. Do not turn absence into a zero-effect individual-object estimate.
whole_strategy.cost: Report actual source costs once plus successor costs; source-learning amortization separately at actual3 targets, not invented future counts.

individual_object.scope: C_keep versus C_minus_one on the same three successor seeds/budget; keep uses original full-C execution. Remove only the preselected new instance; equivalent new/old objects remain.
individual_object.selection: same first lexicographic qualified new candidate fixed before successor labels

new_redundancy_class.scope: C_keep versus C_minus_new_class on same seeds/budget. Only new class aliases and solely derived new contributions may be removed; keep all concrete source Programs/facts/parameters, base language, old templates, and independent old provenance/reconstruction.
new_redundancy_class.class_rule: Use the existing executable-kernel/roles/constraints comparison. Preserve alternative hypotheses/UNKNOWN; do not guess semantic equivalence from IDs, filenames, finite sample predictions or parameter distances.
new_redundancy_class.derivative_closure: Before target labels, enumerate actual candidate aliases, index bindings, transfers/executions and derived policy references. removed_candidates alone is insufficient; audit no automatic rediscovery via removed contribution while keeping ordinary reconstruction legal.
new_redundancy_class.execution_readiness: pending_actual_source_class_and_derivation_manifest; do not claim this intervention executable from a single-ID tombstone
new_redundancy_class.reuse: If individual and class intervention yield literally equal complete inputs/policies, reference the same target execution and charge it once.

endpoints.world_success: Original submitted model + fresh96-row confirmation + independent512-row terminal MSE<=1e-10; report confirmation and terminal separately.
endpoints.independent_prediction: Finite terminal MSE and paired raw MSE difference per simulator instance; all missing/timeout/no-model values remain null with failure status.
endpoints.wrong_transfer: For each matched instance report C-B and keep-remove terminal MSE differences, C failure with comparator success, and actual new-object-to-parent/action provenance. Positive error difference is observed degradation; attribution to an object requires its paired removal result. No new optimized margin.
endpoints.task_coverage: Denominator all registered source/target cases; report submitted/confirmed/evaluable counts separately.
endpoints.mechanism_readouts: Actual generated candidate changes, parent before/after, experimental action choices and forecast differences by saved refs. IDs/nodes/call counts alone are not efficacy.
endpoints.inference_scope: Descriptive paired pilot within existing simulator families, one donor cohort. No population superiority, independent physical mechanism or autonomous LLM discovery claim.

resource_caps.terminal_accounting: Terminal model-row evaluation and terminal Python wall time are external to agent.costs; report separately, at most512 rows per actually submitted final model. These maxima are not prepaid expenses.
resource_caps.python_accounting: 300s per training workspace, with terminal execution timeout300s per submitted model outside agent training cap; no wall-clock completion guarantee.

design.stages_and_authorization: This deliverable prepares all source/target decisions before source labels. The next requested execution is the source stage only:9 native training jobs, no provider. Successor/class execution stays at the separately prepared boundary until the actual frozen source/class inputs can be reviewed.
design.storage: New active continuation under XFS; shared old paid traces by existing references, writable model/fit state independent. Store unique observations/actions/costs/failures/changes and recovery state; no repeated paid trace snapshots or copying full previous training files into packets.
design.limits: No science executed here. No new object or successor outcome exists. No backend discovery or historical-data assembly is evidence of new scientific success.

source.controls: All three groups use Common code_react, the same public task root, complete original archive, tools, budgets and terminal order. B/C automatically route actual task contracts through PR2. Only C consolidates registered source evidence. Fixed libraries constrain automatic organization; ordinary Python, explicit research tools and authored candidates remain available to every group. Target automatic libraries remain frozen. Multi-source C stages reserve their registered cohort-consolidation share inside the unchanged total source allowance.
source.discovery: The preregistered finite procedure runs through the same Common tools and complete Python archive in every group. Its supplied algorithms and any supplied scientific content remain identified as inputs; only actually generated and checked objects are outputs. No model is called.
source.terminal_order: All training stops before terminal labels are generated. Submitted predictor files and their paid training view stay fixed.
source.failure_policy: Keep all initially registered sources and provider, research and confirmation failures.
source.scope: Deterministic development controls on 21 public input levels; learning horizon 24. Terminal horizon 48 tests new paths, not different physical objects. This pilot alone establishes neither recursive superiority nor cross-task meta-prior learning.
